title: Common Ions
page_title: Common Ions | Edexcel IGCSE Chemistry Revision Notes 2017

blocks.name: Common Ions
blocks.definition:
know the charges of these ions: 
• metals in Groups 1, 2 and 3
• non-metals in Groups 5, 6 and 7 
• Ag+, Cu2+, Fe2+, Fe3+, Pb2+, Zn2+
• hydrogen (H+), hydroxide (OH– ), ammonium (NH4 +), carbonate (CO3 2– ), nitrate (NO3 - ), sulfate (SO4 2– ).

blocks.text: How to deduce the charge of an ion

blocks.md:
- Find the number of electrons in the outer electron shell
- Find out if it is easier for the atom to gain electron or to donate electron (in most cases atoms that have fewer than four electrons, donate electrons and atoms that have more than 4 electrons, receive electrons)
- Atoms that gain electrons become negative ions and atoms that donate electron forms positive ion
- You also need to learn the formula of **compound ions**, that is, ions made from more than one element

blocks.text: Common ions with a positive charge

blocks.md:
| **Ion** | **Charge / formula** |
|---|---|
| Group 1 metals | 1+ (E.g. Na<sup>+</sup>) |
| Group 2 metals | 2+ (E.g. Mg<sup>2+</sup>) |
| Group 3 metals | 3+ (E.g. Al<sup>3+</sup>) |
| Silver | Ag<sup>+</sup> |
| Copper(II) | Cu<sup>2+</sup> |
| Iron(II) | Fe<sup>2+</sup> |
| Iron(III) | Fe<sup>3+</sup> |
| Lead(II) | Pb<sup>2+</sup> |
| Zinc(II) | Zn<sup>2+</sup> |
| Hydrogen | H<sup>+</sup> |
| Ammonium | NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup> |

blocks.text: Common ions with a negative charge

blocks.md:
| **Ion** | **Charge / formula** |
|---|---|
| Group 5 non- metals | 3- (E.g. N<sup>3-</sup>) |
| Group 6 non- metals | 2- (E.g. O<sup>2-</sup>) |
| Group 7 non- metals | 1- (E.g. Cl<sup>-)</sup> |
| Hydroxide | OH<sup>-</sup> |
| Carbonate | CO<sub>3</sub><sup>2-</sup> |
| Nitrate | NO<sub>3</sub><sup>-</sup> |
| Sulfate | SO<sub>4</sub><sup>2-</sup> |

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: You **must** know the charges of all the ions shown in the above tables.
